blocks:team-and-mission.title: Team and Mission
blocks:team-and-mission.description: A left-led about section pairing a plain mission, useful facts, and a compact people grid on the system's pink human-context field.

blocks:job-listings-list.title: Job Listings
blocks:job-listings-list.description: The canonical hiring list: one ruled group of scannable role rows with department, location, employment type, and full-row navigation composed inside the Block.

blocks:employee-benefits.title: Employee Benefits
blocks:employee-benefits.description: A green Marker-led benefits region using a ruled two-column list for concrete health, leave, remote, learning, parent, and ownership support without card or icon decoration.

blocks:hiring-process.title: Hiring Process
blocks:hiring-process.description: A plain four-part candidate flow with named actions, useful timing, one contact promise, and no decorative stage labels or numbered timeline furniture.

blocks:culture-and-values.title: Culture and Values
blocks:culture-and-values.description: Four concrete working principles on flat pink human-context fields, led by one Marker and plain explanation without icon cards or testimonial theatre.

blocks:job-application-form.title: Job Application Form
blocks:job-application-form.description: A canonical hiring application flow using the shared field and upload Components, a measured form, and a sticky role-summary Rail.

blocks:internship-program.title: Internship Program
blocks:internship-program.description: A pink Marker-led early-career program with four concrete learning principles, a plain fact rail, and no more than two application actions.

blocks:diversity-and-inclusion.title: Diversity & Inclusion
blocks:diversity-and-inclusion.description: A pink Marker-led inclusion section made of four observable hiring practices, without invented representation statistics or promise cards.

blocks:remote-work-setup.title: Remote Work Setup
blocks:remote-work-setup.description: A green Marker-led remote-work agreement separating what the company provides from how the team agrees to collaborate.

blocks:salary-bands.title: Salary Bands
blocks:salary-bands.description: A green Marker-led pay transparency table with formatted base ranges, ownership context, a visible caption, and a ruled mobile list.

blocks:job-alerts-signup.title: Job Alerts
blocks:job-alerts-signup.description: A compact pink job-alert region composed from Section Header and the shared Email Capture Form, with one consent line and no invented subscriber proof.

blocks:profile-summary.title: Profile Summary
blocks:profile-summary.description: User profile card with cover photo, avatar, bio, location, website, followers/following stats, and follow button.

blocks:notification-feed.title: Notification Feed
blocks:notification-feed.description: Notification list with activity types (likes, comments, follows, mentions), unread indicators, and mark-as-read actions.

blocks:profile-header.title: Profile Header
blocks:profile-header.description: Compact profile card with cover image, avatar, verified badge, bio, location, website, join date, and post/follower stats.

blocks:testimonials.title: Testimonial Grid
blocks:testimonials.description: Grid of testimonial cards with category tags like Performance, Support, or Pricing.

blocks:testimonial-quote.title: Testimonial Quote
blocks:testimonial-quote.description: A green character-led split testimonial pairing one Marker, short quote, named author, and one concrete proof fact without a fake trust cluster or stock avatar.

blocks:rated-testimonial.title: Rated Testimonial
blocks:rated-testimonial.description: A verified-review split pairing a large quote and author with one named-pastel rating field; no decorative image or nested card.
